title: corvex drain hangs forever on macOS (Redis 7.2)

posts.author: devon_k
posts.body: On my Mac (M2, Sonoma) `corvex drain` never returns. It prints `draining: waiting for 0 in-flight jobs` and just sits there. Ctrl-C is the only way out. Same config on our Linux CI drains in about a second. Redis is 7.2.4 from Homebrew. Corvex 2.4.1.

posts.author: mira_s
posts.body: Confirmed here too, also M-series + Homebrew Redis 7.2. It's a keyspace-notification thing: Corvex 2.4 waits on a Redis `BLPOP` for the shutdown ack, and Homebrew's Redis 7.2 ships with `notify-keyspace-events` empty AND has a quirk where a blocking pop on a nonexistent key never times out under the macOS build. Workaround that fixed it for me: set `CORVEX_DRAIN_TIMEOUT=15s` so the drain gives up waiting and exits cleanly. You can also run `redis-server --notify-keyspace-events KEA`.

posts.author: priya_corvex
posts.body: Tracked as CORVEX-3311. The blocking-ack path was replaced with a polled ack in 2.5.0, so upgrading also fixes this. On 2.4.x the `CORVEX_DRAIN_TIMEOUT` workaround above is the right call. This only reproduces on the macOS arm64 Redis build; Linux and the official Redis Docker image are unaffected.
